visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a woman in a white tank top standing in a brightly lit boutique, gesturing enthusiastically towards a rack of elaborate dresses behind her. The lighting is warm and even, highlighting her facial expressions as she speaks directly to the camera with high energy. (2) The scene shifts to the woman wearing a shimmering, strapless silver gown on a circular platform. She twirls, capturing the fabric's reflective quality with her phone. The background features a plush gray sofa and more gowns hanging in the distance, indicating a high-end fitting room. (3) Next, she presents a layered pink gown with floral details. She moves her hands to show off the dress's texture while smiling broadly. The background curtains are neutral, keeping the focus on the vibrant colors of the garment. (4) The woman then tries on a white halter-neck gown with a sparkling bodice. She flexes her arm playfully to show the fit and then twirls, causing the tulle skirt to billow. The camera angle is eye-level, maintaining a personal, selfie-style perspective. (5) Subsequent scenes show her in a black sequined gown with a large bow, a teal sparkling gown with asymmetrical layers, and a gold form-fitting sequined dress. In each, she uses expressive hand gestures and facial movements to convey her delight and personality. (6) The final sequence returns to the woman in a close-up, wearing the black grid-patterned dress. Large text overlays appear with concert information. She waves goodbye with a smile as the scene fades out, maintaining a consistent bright and cheerful tone throughout.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy female voice speaking rapidly with an upward inflection, accompanied by upbeat electronic pop BGM with a steady 4/4 beat. The audio quality is clean, suggesting a direct recording. (2) A 'whoosh' sound transition effect leads into the speaker expressing excitement and singing 'Do re mi' with varying pitch. The BGM continues, providing a consistent rhythmic bed. (3) Another transition SFX marks a shift as the speaker describes a dress's weight. Her tone is slightly more observational but remains high-arousal and cheerful. The BGM swells slightly in the background. (4) A melodic synth line in the BGM becomes more prominent while the speaker continues to narrate her dress-trying experience. There's a 'ding' sound effect when a specific feature is highlighted. (5) The speaker laughs heartily, and the BGM fades out slightly as she concludes her presentation. Final transition SFX with a concluding cheerful vocal sign-off and a short burst of music.
